id: title:MichaelKutsch-ph:push feature flags canary images to the shared services ecr

review.posthog_relevance: Build and release infrastructure: P1.F1.H1 and P1.F1.H2 establish shared ECR push and multi-registry tagging, while P1.F1.H3 preserves the immutable image digest. This supports PostHog's shared-services consumption model and release immutability, not end-user feature or query behavior.
review.reason: Adds AWS credential configuration and ECR push steps, shared multi-registry tagging, and IMAGE_DIGEST preservation. These are CI/CD and release-artifact changes, not changes to PostHog's query planning, warehouse ingestion, or user-facing behavior. The tier is conservative because the benefit is operational and shared, not a change to PostHog's core product capability.
review.uncertainty: This chunk does not demonstrate a change to PostHog's runtime behavior, query results, or warehouse ingestion. The benefit is limited to release and shared-service consumption, which is a valid but narrow operational improvement. No tier assignment is requested, so this is a conservative, code-backed assessment.

observations.limitations: This chunk represents a single workflow change. No other PRs are present, so no relationship uncertainty exists. No tier assignment is requested.

observations.behavior: Adds AWS credential configuration and ECR login steps to push images to a shared-services ECR repository.
observations.code_quote: - name: Configure AWS credentials for the shared-services ECR
observations.posthog_connection: Supports pushing the feature-flags canary image to a shared ECR repository, enabling downstream chart consumers to pull from a replicated location without requiring separate credentials or regional configuration.

observations.behavior: Changes Docker push tags to include both the original GHCR image and the shared-services ECR image, while retaining the same digest.
observations.posthog_connection: Establishes a shared, immutable digest-based reference for the canary image across two registries, supporting a shared-services consumption model.

observations.behavior: Adds IMAGE_DIGEST environment variable to the workflow, populated with the Docker build digest.
observations.posthog_connection: Preserves the immutable image digest for downstream consumers and reporting, supporting digest-based pinning and immutability guarantees.
